# KATA

> Deterministic research automation for humans and agents: live scholarly search, durable browser workspace, reusable workflow programs, HTTPS, remote MCP, browser WebMCP and model-native tool schemas from one canonical engine.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/dharan1007/kata
Live product: https://kata-webmcp.vercel.app/
Remote MCP endpoint: https://kata-webmcp.vercel.app/api/mcp

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/dharan1007/kata/blob/main/README.md
- Security: https://github.com/dharan1007/kata/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Roadmap: https://github.com/dharan1007/kata/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/dharan1007/kata/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- MCP Registry metadata: https://github.com/dharan1007/kata/blob/main/server.json
- Live capabilities: https://kata-webmcp.vercel.app/api/capabilities
- Live OpenAPI: https://kata-webmcp.vercel.app/api/openapi

## Core facts

- Node.js: 24.x release/runtime contract.
- Runtime npm dependencies: none in the current package.
- Production research connector: OpenAlex.
- Upstream failures: explicit; no synthetic success fallback.
- Workspace: browser-owned durable versioned state.
- Programs: two-demonstration anti-unification into validated reusable programs.
- Agent surfaces: generic HTTPS, remote MCP, browser WebMCP, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-style schemas.
- Remote MCP: `/api/mcp`.
- Security: canonical schema validation, bounded bodies, origin controls, no arbitrary shell/eval URL-fetch tool.
- License: MIT.

## Current boundary

Browser triggers run while KATA is open. The current release is not an unattended authenticated cloud scheduler. Protocol behavior must be read from the checked-in tests and `/api/capabilities`; do not infer support from project marketing alone.
